mapper.sql: RECORD_ID, COLLABORATION_TYPE, SOURCE_SYSTEM, TARGET_SYSTEM, DATA_TYPE, DATA_CONTENT, COLLABORATION_STATUS, START_TIME, END_TIME, DURATION, SUCCESS_COUNT, FAILURE_COUNT, TOTAL_COUNT, TRIGGER_TYPE, ERROR_MESSAGE, RETRY_COUNT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE COLLABORATION_TYPE = #{collaborationType} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE COLLABORATION_STATUS = #{collaborationStatus} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM = #{sourceSystem} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE TARGET_SYSTEM = #{targetSystem} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE COLLABORATION_STATUS IN ('PROCESSING', 'PENDING') ORDER BY START_TIME ASC
SELECT FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'FAILED' ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD SET COLLABORATION_STATUS = #{collaborationStatus},
ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage},
UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE NOW()
WHERE RECORD_ID = #{recordId}

UPDATE SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD SET END_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE NOW() , DURATION =
TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, START_TIME, NOW()) (SYSDATE - START_TIME) * 24 * 60 * 60 EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - START_TIME)) , UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE NOW()
WHERE RECORD_ID = #{recordId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRecords, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 END) as processingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as successCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) as cancelledCount, AVG(DURATION) as avgDuration, MAX(DURATION) as maxDuration, MIN(DURATION) as minDuration, SUM(SUCCESS_COUNT) as totalSuccessCount, SUM(FAILURE_COUNT) as totalFailureCount, SUM(TOTAL_COUNT) as totalProcessedCount FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD

SELECT COLLABORATION_TYPE as type, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD), 2) as percentage FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD GROUP BY COLLABORATION_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COLLABORATION_STATUS as status, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD), 2) as percentage FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD GROUP BY COLLABORATION_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT SOURCE_SYSTEM as sourceSystem, TARGET_SYSTEM as targetSystem, COUNT(*) as collaborationCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as successCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failedCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as successRate FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD GROUP BY SOURCE_SYSTEM, TARGET_SYSTEM ORDER BY collaborationCount DESC

SELECT AVG(DURATION) as avgDuration, MAX(DURATION) as maxDuration, MIN(DURATION) as minDuration, AVG(TOTAL_COUNT) as avgTotalCount, MAX(TOTAL_COUNT) as maxTotalCount, MIN(TOTAL_COUNT) as minTotalCount, SUM(SUCCESS_COUNT) as totalSuccessCount, SUM(FAILURE_COUNT) as totalFailureCount, SUM(TOTAL_COUNT) as totalProcessedCount, ROUND(SUM(SUCCESS_COUNT) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(TOTAL_COUNT), 0), 2) as overallSuccessRate FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE COLLABORATION_STATUS IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')

SELECT
DATE(START_TIME) as collaborationDate,
TO_CHAR(START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as collaborationDate,
DATE(START_TIME) as collaborationDate,
COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as successCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failedCount, AVG(DURATION) as avgDuration FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE START_TIME BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY
DATE(START_TIME)
TO_CHAR(START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
DATE(START_TIME)
ORDER BY collaborationDate ASC
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE COLLABORATION_STATUS IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND CREATE_TIME <
DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) SYSDATE - #{days} NOW() - INTERVAL '#{days}' DAY
mapper.select: SELECT COLLABORATION_TYPE as collaborationType, SOURCE_SYSTEM as sourceSystem, TARGET_SYSTEM as targetSystem, COUNT(*) as totalCollaborations, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as successCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failedCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN COLLABORATION_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as successRate, AVG(DURATION) as avgDuration, AVG(RETRY_COUNT) as avgRetryCount, SUM(SUCCESS_COUNT) as totalSuccessRecords, SUM(FAILURE_COUNT) as totalFailureRecords, SUM(TOTAL_COUNT) as totalProcessedRecords FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD WHERE START_TIME BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY COLLABORATION_TYPE, SOURCE_SYSTEM, TARGET_SYSTEM ORDER BY totalCollaborations DESC, successRate DESC

SELECT FROM SYS_DATA_COLLABORATION_RECORD
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
